example.title: XOR of eight letters in 4-byte blocks
example.note: The two 4-byte blocks are xored column by column, which gives four bytes: 0404040c.

name: blocksize 3 of abcdefgh
ref: hand-computed columns: 61^64^67, 62^65^68, 63^66 (last block zero-padded); re-run with a plain loop

example.title: The last block is padded with zeros
example.note: Eight bytes in blocks of 3 leave two bytes in the last block. It is padded with a zero, so the result is still three bytes.

name: blocksize 1 of abcdefgh
ref: a block size of 1 xors every byte

name: blocksize 16 of abcdefgh
